description: This file manages API key configurations and retrieval for various providers, including functions to parse environment variables, resolve provider configurations, and check for rate limit or billing errors.

methods.name: parseKeyList
methods.description: Parses a raw string into an array of trimmed, non-empty keys.

methods.name: collectEnvPrefixedKeys
methods.description: Collects environment variable values that start with a specific prefix.

methods.name: resolveProviderApiKeyConfig
methods.description: Resolves the API key configuration for a given provider, applying overrides and defaults.

methods.name: collectProviderApiKeys
methods.description: Collects API keys for a specified provider from environment variables, considering overrides and fallbacks.

methods.name: collectAnthropicApiKeys
methods.description: Collects API keys specifically for the 'anthropic' provider.

methods.name: collectGeminiApiKeys
methods.description: Collects API keys specifically for the 'google' provider (used for Gemini).

methods.name: isApiKeyRateLimitError
methods.description: Checks if a message indicates an API rate limit error.

methods.name: isAnthropicRateLimitError
methods.description: Checks if a message indicates an rate limit error for Anthropic.

methods.name: isAnthropicBillingError
methods.description: Checks if a message indicates a billing-related error for Anthropic.
